resumeText:
Sruthi Venkatesan | Bengaluru | sruthi.v@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering, PES University, Bengaluru, 2026 | CGPA 8.8/10

INTERNSHIPS
RTL Design Intern, Nandi Silicon Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru | Jan 2026 - May 2026 (12 weeks)
- Wrote synthesizable Verilog RTL for a UART transmitter and receiver and debugged it in simulation.
- Ran simulation and lint jobs for the block on the team's Linux servers.
- Wrote Python scripts to parse simulation logs and summarize pass and fail counts.

Summer Intern, Electronic City Semiconductor Training Centre, Bengaluru | June 2025 - July 2025 (8 weeks)
- Completed a guided lab course on Verilog and digital design flow.

PROJECTS
- 32-bit RISC-V core: Single-cycle RV32I processor in Verilog, simulated with Icarus Verilog and GTKWave.
- Traffic light controller: Designed a Moore FSM with flip-flops and verified its state transitions for the Digital Design course.
- 4-bit ALU on FPGA board for the Digital Electronics lab.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Digital Design, CMOS VLSI Design, Computer Architecture, Static Timing Analysis (elective)
- NPTEL: Hardware Modeling using Verilog (Elite + Silver), 2025

SKILLS
Verilog, SystemVerilog (basics), UVM (basics), Linux, Python, Tcl (basics), Xilinx Vivado, Icarus Verilog, Synopsys Design Compiler (training)

ACTIVITIES
- Secretary, IEEE Circuits and Systems student chapter.
